title: Nanoscale zero-valent iron increases rice grain quality and suppresses polychlorinated biphenyl accumulation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01108B, Paper
Yunbu Dai, Hui Jin, Ting Wu, Xinyi Liao, Tianying Zheng, Jianying Zhang, Jie Hou, Daohui Lin
This work extends current understanding by revealing the overlooked effects of Fe-based nanoparticles on aboveground crop functions and their active participation in pollutant attenuation.
